acceptance_cases: Both fixed #50 normal/liquidation lifecycle requests reach durable Prepared, exact stored bytes/native commitments, then fixed-lane Pending->Outcome over actual owned HTTP sockets.

Every semantic wire refusal starts from a separate successful baseline. Exact program/key/ELF/domain, request/material/full-container correspondence, clock receipt/epoch, report input/evidence and 32-byte native commitment enforced.

Drop acknowledgement after one recorded clock/report/broadcast effect; inspect exact durable Pending; fresh refuses; reopened Resume performs only lookups, no second registration/broadcast and same source/plan identity.
Wrong local version/target/trusted material refuses before any connection; wrong peer identity refuses before mutating wire operation. Wrong action/exchange/operation/request/nonce/lane is rejected.

Response framing matrices: duplicate Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, missing/incorrect size, oversize header/body, malformed version/content type, truncation, trailing frame, payload checksum, status errors/redirects and bounded deadlines.

Lookup Pending/Absent/Unknown/Reorg all retain original state/HOLD; finalized identity/effect/finality mismatch refused; success and finalized mock revert exactly persisted; terminal replay zero HTTP callbacks.
Persistence definite/ambiguous failures do not cause a network retry; exact reconciliation required after reload. Existing ownership and shared validator tests remain unchanged.
critical_recovery_rules: ClockPending/ReportsPending/Pending are durable before respective HTTP mutation. An HTTP timeout, truncated reply, connection loss, malformed acknowledgement or identity failure must stop later callbacks and leave original pending cut.

No automatic registration or broadcast retry. Resume only looks up saved immutable operation/attempt identity; absent/unknown/pending/reorg remains HOLD. Prove may repeat after Prepared save failure per existing nonfinancial schedule.

Receipt/status must not be equated to finality. Finalized response carries exact original anchor/target/value and caller-owned consistency metadata; unchanged pure validators enforce epoch/time/finality/order.
Mock attempt_id/mock_tx_id are domain-separated offline IDs, never signed Ethereum transaction hashes. Any proof/outcome/material/nonce/lane change refuses exact persisted plan match.

Terminal Prepared/Outcome resume returns with zero callbacks, so a pure constructor must not send identity HTTP eagerly. A terminal stored outcome is historical recorded consistency, not newly observed canonical-chain finality.

Keep original source clock/report timestamps and full report containers; DPCLK3 outer witness and inner clock version2 are different domains. Full Entry ABI input hash is distinct from body evidence hash.

recommended_packet.boundary: Owned loopback HTTP fixture only; implements unchanged PreparationTransport and BroadcastTransport; not legacy ProverClient, a real candidate prover, live registry or Ethereum transaction sender.
recommended_packet.constructor: FixtureTransport::new(SocketAddr, &ProtocolRequest, &TrustedRequest, &BridgeTarget, sender:[u8;20], nonce:u64), pure validation/no network; exact final names to be agreed with adapter owner.
recommended_packet.durability: Coordinators retain sole checkpoint and lease authority. New transport never writes/reseals/replaces Prepared, source binding, fixed broadcast lane or outcomes.
recommended_packet.peer_identity: New explicitly fixture-only wire identity; candidate pinned program is expected declaration, native replay and opaque mock proof are explicit. All release/attestation/live-candidate-submission claims false/HOLD. Current arcora-public-service-identity/v1 remains unchanged, and legacy DPCLK2 identity remains an incompatible peer.

wire_recommendations.body: Bound raw frame before allocation, reject noncanonical/trailing/foreign codecs. Server compares full opaque request bytes to pinned owned corpus before decoding ProtocolRequest; do not deserialize an arbitrary network ProtocolRequest with derived unbounded Vec/String allocation. Proof response uses exact 32-byte public values, pinned program fields and bounded <=1MiB opaque mock proof.
wire_recommendations.deadline: Finite connect/read/write socket limits plus monotonic checked operation budget at chunk boundaries; do not claim a hard asynchronous preemption or proving-capacity measurement.
wire_recommendations.endpoint: Typed numeric SocketAddr, loopback only, caller-owned ephemeral port; no URL, DNS, proxy, credentials, discovery, env lookup or redirects.
wire_recommendations.frame: Fixed magic/version/action/status plus request SHA256, fresh exchange ID, immutable operation/effect ID, explicit payload length and SHA256. Response must echo identity/action/exchange/operation/request; validate before converting to existing DTOs.
wire_recommendations.http: One request per connection, strict bounded headers, fixed Content-Length, application/octet-stream, Connection: close; refuse duplicate/conflicting lengths, Transfer-Encoding/chunking/compression, status/version/path mismatch and trailing body.
wire_recommendations.privacy: No request/response bodies, witness, reports, auth material or endpoints in errors. Receipt only action, length, digest, counts and stage; synthetic owned loopback data only.
